_about: Visual looks offered to the user. Each shot's prompt carries its own setting, light, grade and sound lines, because a setting shared across shots drags outdoor shots indoors. fade: whether multi-shot edits cross-fade (true) or cut (false) by default.

looks.name: Same as my photo
looks.pitch: Keeps the background, floor and light of your own product photo, so the video looks like your photo coming to life.
looks.best_for: Mannequin 360° and any video made from photos taken in your own shop or studio
looks.setting: exactly the same background, floor and surroundings as in the first product photo, extended naturally to fill the frame
looks.light: the same lighting as in the first product photo
looks.grade: true to the product photo, natural colours
looks.sound: quiet indoor room tone; no music, no speech

looks.name: Clean studio
looks.pitch: Seamless light-grey studio, soft even light, true colours. The classic catalogue look.
looks.best_for: Etsy, Alibaba, website product pages, any product
looks.setting: a seamless light grey photo studio cyclorama with nothing else in view
looks.light: soft, even, shadowless studio lighting from large softboxes; true, accurate colours
looks.sound: quiet studio room tone and soft footsteps; no music, no speech

looks.name: Fashion editorial
looks.pitch: Hard directional light, deep shadows and a coloured backdrop, like a magazine shoot.
looks.best_for: Fashion brands, streetwear, premium outerwear, Instagram
looks.setting: a fashion studio with a plain deep-coloured paper backdrop
looks.light: hard directional key light from one side with crisp shadows and a subtle rim light
looks.sound: quiet studio room tone; no music, no speech

looks.name: Golden hour
looks.pitch: Warm low sunlight outdoors, soft background blur, a relaxed lifestyle feel.
looks.best_for: Casual wear, hoodies, lifestyle brands, Reels
looks.setting: an open rooftop at sunset with the city softly out of focus behind
looks.light: warm, low golden-hour sunlight from behind and to the side, gentle lens flare
looks.grade: warm, soft, cinematic lifestyle look with shallow depth of field
looks.sound: light breeze and distant city ambience; no music, no speech

looks.name: Urban street
looks.pitch: Concrete city streets on an overcast day, authentic and a little gritty.
looks.best_for: Streetwear, hoodies, cargo pants, jackets, TikTok
looks.setting: a quiet city street with concrete walls and pavements, no readable signs or logos
looks.grade: slightly desaturated, cool, authentic street-style look
looks.sound: city street ambience, distant traffic and footsteps; no music, no speech

looks.name: Stadium floodlights
looks.pitch: A pitch or court at night under floodlights with a little haze. Energetic.
looks.best_for: Teamwear, football and basketball kits, tracksuits
looks.setting: a sports pitch at night under bright stadium floodlights, empty stands softly out of focus
looks.light: bright white floodlights from high above with light haze in the beams
looks.sound: open stadium ambience, distant echoing crowd murmur, ball and footstep sounds; no music, no speech

looks.name: Gym grit
looks.pitch: A dark gym or fight club with rim lights, chalk dust and sweat.
looks.best_for: Fightwear, rash guards, shorts, gym and activewear
looks.setting: a dark, gritty training gym with heavy bags and a ring softly out of focus
looks.light: moody low-key lighting with strong rim lights and light chalk dust in the air
looks.sound: gym ambience, breathing, the thud of pads and bags; no music, no speech

looks.name: Luxury dark
looks.pitch: A black set with one spotlight and slow, deliberate movement. Premium.
looks.best_for: Leather jackets, premium outerwear, launches and heroes
looks.setting: a pure black studio set with nothing else in view
looks.light: a single soft spotlight from above with gentle falloff into black, light haze
looks.grade: rich, deep blacks, premium luxury look
looks.sound: deep, quiet room tone; no music, no speech

looks.name: Neon night
looks.pitch: A city at night after rain, wet streets reflecting coloured light.
looks.setting: a city street at night after rain, wet ground reflecting coloured lights, no readable signs
looks.light: coloured neon light in magenta and cyan mixed with street lights
looks.grade: moody cinematic night look, rich colour
looks.sound: night city ambience, light rain drips, distant traffic; no music, no speech

looks.name: Outdoors
looks.pitch: A forest trail or open hills in natural light.
looks.best_for: Hunting and outdoor wear, windbreakers, rain jackets, hiking
looks.setting: a woodland trail with autumn trees and open hills beyond
looks.light: natural daylight filtering through the trees
looks.sound: birdsong, wind through the trees, footsteps on leaves; no music, no speech

looks.name: Phone camera at home
looks.pitch: Natural daylight in a bedroom or hallway, filmed on a phone. Real-customer feel.
looks.best_for: TikTok and Reels ads, D2C, casual wear
looks.setting: a bright, tidy bedroom with a full-length mirror
looks.grade: natural smartphone video look, true to life
looks.sound: quiet room ambience; no music, no speech

looks.name: Factory floor
looks.pitch: A bright, clean, modern garment factory. For telling your manufacturing story.
looks.setting: a bright, clean, modern garment factory
looks.sound: factory ambience, sewing machines humming; no music, no speech
